grading_methods.rule_based: Deterministic assertion in code: exact match, schema/shape check, or regex-based extraction and comparison. Zero-cost, runs on every change.
grading_methods.llm_judge_reference_grounded: LLM is given the same structured source data the system had, and grades whether the output is fully supported by it. Requires calibration (see calibration_protocol) before being trusted unsupervised.
grading_methods.trajectory_check: Rule-based inspection of the sequence of tool calls an agent made: tool names, parameters, and order, including whether it stopped at an approval gate.
grading_methods.human: Manual grading by the builder against a golden transcript or direct judgment call, used for end-to-end and safety-relevant cases.

calibration_protocol.sample_size: 15-20 (scaled down from the standard ~50 due to hackathon timeline; see Anumaan_Evals_v1.md Section 3)
calibration_protocol.action_if_below_target: Revise the judge's grading rubric/prompt before trusting it further; do not proceed on ungraded trust.

multi_trial_sampling.rationale: Agents are stochastic; a single pass/fail hides variance that could surface live during the demo.
